quotes.text: Se dedica exclusivamente a las labores del hogar .........................3

assessments.reasoning: The supplied survey instrument does not contain a separate module dedicated to unpaid domestic or care work. Unpaid domestic work ("labores del hogar") is only mentioned in Section 6 (Empleo e Ingreso) as a reason for not being available to start work (Pregunta 5, code 3) or for not seeking work during the reference period (Pregunta 8, code 6), treating it as a category of inactivity rather than measuring it through a separate questionnaire module.
